tasks.analysis: Water is essential for life as we know it, so finding water on other planets and moons is a crucial part of the quest to find life beyond Earth. Mars’ riverbeds show evidence of water in ancient times.The moons Europa and Enceladus have ice-covered surfaces that may hide oceans beneath. Discovering new extraterrestrial water, whether past or present, liquid or solid, could significantly impact our understanding of life in the universe. Such findings could guide future missions in the search for habitable environments outside of Earth. 正如我们所知，水是生命必不可少的物质，因此在其他行星和卫星上寻找水，是探索地球以外生命的关键部分。火星的河床显示出远古时期存在水的证据。木卫二（欧罗巴）和土卫二（恩克拉多斯）这两颗卫星拥有被冰覆盖的表面，其下方可能隐藏着海洋。发现新的地球外水资源 —— 无论是过去还是现在存在的，液态还是固态 —— 都可能极大地影响我们对宇宙中生命的理解。这些发现可以为未来探索地球以外宜居环境的任务提供指导。
